Hero.subtitle: Maputo Province prepares its participation in Mozambique's largest international fair. Join hundreds of companies and showcase our region's potential.

About.title: Showing Maputo's Potential to the World
About.p1: The Provincial Directorate of Industry and Commerce coordinates Maputo Province's participation in FACIM 2026, mobilizing companies from all 8 districts for a collective demonstration of economic strength, innovation, and productive capacity.
About.p2: This platform centralizes the entire process — from registration to participation — ensuring transparency, efficiency, and a modern digital experience for all stakeholders.
About.objectiveDesc: Digitize and centralize the entire management of provincial participation
About.impactDesc: Increase institutional visibility and business mobilization

hero.title: On the way to
hero.sub: The Provincial Directorate of Industry and Commerce of Maputo coordinates the preparation, promotion, and management of Maputo Province's participation in the 61st Edition of the Mozambique Agricultural, Commercial and Industrial Fair.

mission.title: Showing Maputo's Economic Potential
mission.p1: The "On the way to FACIM" campaign aims to mobilize companies from all 8 districts of Maputo Province for a collective, organized, and impactful participation in Mozambique's largest international fair.
mission.p2: Through this digital platform, we intend to modernize all preparation logistics — from online registration to sponsorship management and institutional communication — ensuring efficiency, transparency, and accessibility.
